text:
isabel: Thanks for the infra update. Two quick asks from comms: a short customer-friendly sentence for the APAC pilot, and a one-liner support script for when customers report higher latency.

sophia: Draft customer line: "We're targeting an invite-only APAC pilot in late September; broader availability is expected in early Q4, subject to hardware delivery timelines." Will avoid hard dates.

henry: For support script: 1) acknowledge, 2) check region health, 3) confirm whether cross-region routing occurred, 4) offer pilot channel if applicable. Short copy pls.

sophia: Support paste: "Thanks — we're looking into this. Please confirm your region and we'll check if your requests were routed cross-region; pilot customers get a dedicated channel for updates."

lina: Procurement update: vendor F reported a 2-week delay on an APAC crate, impacting H100 availability. Posting details to #procurement-watch.

capacity-bot: Snapshot (ts 2144500100):
region: availability_pct
US-West: 90%
US-East: 86%
EMEA: 64%
APAC: 36%

sophia: Runbook note for ops: proposed automated thresholds - under 60% -> flag region as "low"; under 40% -> warm cross-region pool for priority routes; under 20% -> enable quantized fallback and throttle non-critical routes. We'll PR the flowchart.

isabel: Can infra also give rough latency deltas so product can set expectations? Even ballpark numbers are fine.

sophia: Ballpark p95s: in-region warm pool: +10-30ms; cross-region (same continent): +50-180ms; quantized fallback: +120-350ms and potential small quality change. I'll add p50/p95 table to the PR.

henry: Action items roundup: sophia -> one-paragraph comms + p50/p95 table (due Mon); lina -> procurement details to #procurement-watch (today); ops -> runbook PR once numbers posted (arjun/oliver). I'll draft a 2-line CS paste and drop in #support-ready.

maria: Please CC exec-comm on the final comms blurb. Also, legal: double-check the Dedicated region-pinning language before we publish.

sophia: Noted. Policy: Dedicated/Private respect region pinning; cross-region fallback only with explicit opt-in. We'll provide legal-friendly wording in the PR.

isabel: Thanks all. Small ask: include a short checkbox list in the PR so comms can tick off approvals. :thumbsup:
